name: gfx_cmdbuf
doc: Recording state of one NVN command buffer (src/gfx/cmd.ts; nxnative cmd_t.recording 0 / 2 / 1). Begun is a recording with no record yet: its first record becomes the command handle. AddCommandMemory is not an event: memory may be added in any state. Restart is BeginRecording while a recording is open, which nxnative reports red and restarts.
